sources: Normattiva (Istituto Poligrafico e Zecca dello Stato)
Decree-Law 11 October 2024 n. 145, art. 3, current version (updated to acts published by 28 February 2026; English machine translation saved by a team member)

facts.c: Normattiva's current text of Decree-Law 145/2024 is updated to acts published up to 28 February 2026
facts.q: (Last updated to the document published on February 28, 2026)

facts.c: In the current text, art. 3 (in force since 11 December 2024) still applies the extra checks to Bangladesh, Pakistan and Sri Lanka only until 31 December 2025, pending the Foreign Minister's decree listing high-risk countries; it has not been extended
facts.q: Until December 31, 2025, pending the adoption of the decree referred to in the first sentence, paragraphs 1 and 2 apply to applications for authorizations and authorizations for workers who are citizens of Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.
v: Bangladesh extra nulla osta checks (DL 145/2024 art. 3)
until 31 Dec 2025, not extended (text to 28 Feb 2026)

facts.c: The high-risk countries under art. 3 are to be named by decree of the Minister of Foreign Affairs
facts.q: The states and territories referred to in paragraph 1 are identified by decree of the Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation.

facts.c: For high-risk countries, the nulla osta is not issued automatically by silent consent; it is issued only after the National Labour Inspectorate checks the requirements
facts.q: does not apply and the work permit can be issued after verification
